name: Estival-Karst
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by bioluminescent seas. Beyond massive canyon systems, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
There is money in rare flora here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
